plans_audited.summary: 6-component architecture for full completion. Each component is PLANNED — none implemented as standalone modules.

sections.expected_output: Per-scenario required_options_class, required_inputs, known_invalid_patterns, few_shot_required, completion_blocker
sections.root_cause: No scenario contract module or artifact found. scenario-catalog.json is shallow (lacks required_options_class, known_invalid_patterns). This is a foundational architectural gap — without contracts, reruns cannot be pre-validated.

sections.expected_output: State machine with states: discovered > classified > contract_defined > ready_to_generate > ... > merged
sections.root_cause: LIFECYCLE_STAGES in example_lifecycle.py is a linear stage list, not a state machine with re-entry. No re-entry from backlogged → ready_to_generate. Completion queue artifact does not exist.

sections.expected_output: Backlog failures become negative constraints; successful code becomes few-shot templates; targeted repair
sections.root_cause: FORBIDDEN constraints in packet_builder.py are manually maintained (not auto-generated from backlog). Few-shot examples in llm-fewshot-patterns.json are static, not auto-updated. The repair prompt gap (not re-injecting FORBIDDEN constraint after repair) was identified in r1-pdf-optimizer-rerun-result.md — this is the Learning/Repair system's critical weakness.

sections.expected_output: Auto-create taskcard entries when scenarios enter backlogged state
sections.root_cause: PDF backlog directory exists. Taskcard bridge is MANUAL, not automated. No source module auto-creates taskcards from backlog state transitions. Cells and Words have no backlog directories.

sections.expected_output: New fields: full_completion_possible, true_completion_rate, next_blocker_to_clear
sections.root_cause: family-generation-readiness-rank.json exists but does not include full_completion_possible or true_completion_rate. No source module computes these fields.

sections.expected_output: Codified policy: controlled pilot / full family launch / monthly updates
sections.root_cause: Controlled pilot policy is implicit in allowed_types YML. Monthly maintenance runbook exists. Full family launch policy is not codified as a programmatic gate — it's in documentation only.

plans_audited.summary: TC14 Sprint 2 gate checklist. Shows AGENT_METRICS_PRODUCTION_ENABLED=true was used as command-line env var for production POST (not gated in source code). 18 items: 14 agent-verified PASS, 4 PENDING_HUMAN (resolved by human approval before actual run).

sections.expected_output: AGENT_METRICS_PRODUCTION_ENABLED=true required as external gate for production POST
sections.root_cause: The env var is an operator-level gate (set in shell before running), not a programmatic check in poster.py. This is consistent with design: the source code uses dry_run parameter + test_only_sprint, and the operator provides AGENT_METRICS_DRY_RUN=false + AGENT_METRICS_PRODUCTION_ENABLED=true at command invocation. The gate works but is convention-based, not code-enforced.
